objective: The waves' enemies are the Hexbound, evil magic knights, ogres and dragons, instead of animals: a foe roster the existing fight rules use, dragons as the boss of every 10th wave, tests, and a look-test of the three models as Blender previews.
acceptance_criteria: A foe has the six stats, a role, a group and a kind, is never a species, and fights through BattleRules by its role and group
Wave enemies are foes: knights only for waves 1 to 4, ogres from 5, the warlord from 15; every 10th wave ends with a dragon, a stronger one from waves 30 and 60; no other wave has a dragon
The waves stay about as hard as before: starters, trained starters, a Titan and mythics reach roughly the waves they did
tools/blender/stations/build.py --draft renders the knight, ogre and dragon
